description: Private data + untrusted content + external communication in one context. Any injection in the untrusted content can then read the data and send it out.
One of the three properties. A tool, an input or a renderer can provide one or more legs.
Everything that shares one context: the tools available, the inputs that started it, the UI that renders its output. Legs are analyzed per session.
Any way data can leave: sending email, fetching a URL with data in it, rendering a remote image, opening an issue in a public tracker.
When information is missing (an unlabeled tool), assume the dangerous case. A false alarm is cheap; a missed leg is a breach.
Tracks the legs a session has touched and denies the call that would complete the trifecta, so call order and dynamically loaded tools are covered.
